# MosqueAI

> MosqueAI is a 24/7 AI phone receptionist for UK mosques. It answers routine enquiries, passes urgent calls (such as janazah arrangements) straight to a real person, sends the committee a text summary after every call, and gives volunteers their time back.

MosqueAI is built by Simply Genius AI, based in Manchester, UK. It is a paid service sold to mosque committees, not a mosque's own website — it does not display prayer times or accept donations itself.

## Key facts

- Phone: +44 7974 457772
- Location: Manchester, UK
- Website: https://mosqueai.co.uk
- Setup time: most mosques are live within one to two weeks
- Languages: English, Arabic, Urdu, Bengali and others, depending on the caller
- Contract: no long-term contract, month to month, cancel any time

## What it does

- Answers routine questions: prayer times, Jumu'ah, madrasah, parking and directions
- Routes urgent calls (janazah, emergencies) straight to a nominated person on the committee
- Sends a text summary after every call: who rang, what they needed, what happens next
- Filters out sales and spam calls before they reach the committee
- Routes new Muslim enquiries and fiqh questions to the Imam or coordinator
- Answers after Isha and on Eid, when no one is in the office
- Handles several calls at once during busy periods (Ramadan, Jumu'ah)
- Is trained only on the mosque's own approved information, so answers are consistent
